title: Tricky TH Sounds
subtitle: Voiced & Voiceless TH
description: Master the two TH sounds: the voiceless /θ/ in 'think' and the voiced /ð/ in 'this'. Both require placing your tongue lightly between your teeth.
tip: Touch the tip of your tongue to the edge of your upper front teeth and blow air through — don't tuck your tongue all the way in.
phrases: Though he thought it through, he wasn't thoroughly sure.
Thirty-three thieves thought they had the throne.
Whether the weather is cold or whether it's hot, we'll weather the weather.
This and that, these and those, then and there.
The thing is, I think there's something they're not telling us.
They bathed the other three together on Thursday.
Neither the father nor the mother noticed the other threat.
Thank them for both the thought and the thoughtful gift.
